notes: New in 4.0: a frozen channel now restarts by itself, even when the sound keeps playing. Smoother, iOS-style screens: the list glides and the selected channel stays near the middle. A new version shows an "Update now" button on the home screen.
notes_en: New in 4.0: a frozen channel now restarts by itself, even when the sound keeps playing. Smoother, iOS-style screens: the list glides and the selected channel stays near the middle. A new version shows an "Update now" button on the home screen.
notes_sq: E re në 4.0: kanali që ngrin rihapet vetë, edhe kur zëri vazhdon. Pamje më e butë si në iOS: lista rrëshqet butë dhe kanali i zgjedhur qëndron afër mesit. Versioni i ri shfaq butonin "Update now" në ekranin kryesor.
